references.title: DWDS: Paddelboot
references.supports: The Wortzerlegung 1Paddel Boot, linking the noun das Paddel, not the verb paddeln; the Etymologie: Paddelboot n. 'mit einem Paddel fortzubewegendes Boot'

notes.rationale: DWDS splits it Paddel + Boot: Paddel is the noun here, though it also spells the stem of paddeln, a verb made from it (ADR 0050: the DWDS Wortzerlegung decides). Schaukelpferd, the same shape, links the verb schaukeln instead.
